objective: Issue #53, server only: implement the 'Tutor notes' section of packages/chess-core/src/api.ts (committed at 1e382ac, read it in full — it is the spec). When a tutor question closes because its position is left, record a TutorNote in the game and send it in every GameView (GameView.notes, always present, [] when none): on the player's move from attemptFen (graded try: attempt filled) or from another position (moved on: attempt null), at game end (finished, resigned, abandoned) for a question still open or shown, and when a new tutor ask replaces a question. The note carries the question message, the reveal text (HeldQuestion.reveal, null if none), bestMove = the engine's best move in the note's position from the analysis the server already has for that position (the one moveLoss grades against), as a legal MoveView (by 'player'), never from the model; null if no evaluation, and the attempt. A takeback removes every note with ply >= the new moves.length and never reopens a closed question. Notes are saved in the v2 state JSON before the reply/event that carries them, come back after a restart (old state rows without notes load as []), and the saved PGN writes each note as a {...} comment after the move moves[ply] (or after the last move when ply === moves.length). The open question's reveal still never reaches the browser before the question closes (FR-8).
